lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: One road, and men on it who have decided the road is theirs.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: They will want coin first and blood second. We are not carrying enough of the one to avoid the other.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: They ran before the last of them fell. That is not the same as being finished with us.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Whatever they were guarding, it was not this road.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: Back to the treeline. Nobody is dead who will not walk again by morning.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: We go again — and this time we do not let them choose the ground.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: The water is shallow and the far bank is high. Whoever waits up there gets the first shot and the last word.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: Cross fast or do not cross at all.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: They knew we were coming. Someone told them, and it was not a guess.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: Wash the ford water off before it sets. We are not stopping here.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Fall back across. The river does not care who holds it.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: We learn the bank and we take it properly.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: A watchtower with nobody watching, and a fire someone banked an hour ago.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: There is a hexer inside. I can feel the shape of what they have been doing in there.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Whatever the hexer was, it was not a brigand. Brigands do not keep a ledger.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Vance is reading it. He has gone quiet, which is worse than shouting.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: That was not a fight we lost. That was a fight we walked into badly.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: Change what you carry. The tower will still be there.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: The bridge is half down and the half that stands is held by people who broke it.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Nobody destroys their own crossing unless they are keeping something on the other side.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: The marauders were paid. Not in loot — in coin, minted, and not from any purse on this road.

lines.speaker: briar
lines.text: One camp left, and it is the one they were all being paid out of.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: Off the span. Falling is not a way to win an argument.

lines.speaker: kest
lines.text: We come back at it with something they have not seen us do yet.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Everything since the toll road has been someone else's errand, run by someone else's hand.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: The warchief is the last knuckle of it. Not the hand. But it is what we can reach today.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: It is over, and it is not finished. The ledger named a place none of us have been.

lines.speaker: ottoline
lines.text: For tonight, the road is a road again. That will do.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Out. Now. We do not die in someone else's camp for someone else's reasons.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: We came this far by changing. Change again, and we come back.
